status: Implemented and published to GitHub as0.3.3; Google Play internal track accepted code29. Production remains blocked by Play listing validation permission denial.
behavior: Opaque inset floating card reserves page space instead of covering reading content.
Inset icon-and-label Text/PDF selector, medium circular primary control, speed and up-arrow.
Permanent progress rail and status slot retain their geometry across audio states.
Optional compact performance summary is inside the card, with existing detail and hide actions.
Reader controls > Quick > Show performance info toggles the saved showPerformance preference.
Changing performance visibility does not invoke speech-performance updates or pause playback.
Full prepare-ahead progress and Cancel remain available through the card's Reading details action.
Controls-sheet footer reserves two status lines and prioritizes errors.
validationScope: Compose layout/action tests, source unit tests, lint, signed artifact verification, and real Android emulator preparation/playback/toggle-persistence checks. No physical-phone test.
